head_commit.message:
Vol targeting + cross-asset sleeve; live default -> S&P 500 @ 0.20 vol target

Vol targeting (src/strategies/weekly_momentum.py):
- exposure_fn seam on compute_target_weights/run_walkforward (no-op at
  default); realized_portfolio_vol uses the FULL trailing covariance
  (diagonal-only would under-estimate a correlated book ~30% and
  over-lever); vol_target_exposure takes max(21d, 63d) so it de-risks
  fast and re-risks slowly; hard 1.0 cap - no leverage.

Cross-asset trend sleeve (main/backtest_cross_asset.py):
- Same machinery on 9 asset-class ETFs, top-4, 10% vol target, no dma
  gate (bonds/gold are the defensive asset). 2008-2026 @ 5bps: Sharpe
  0.75, MaxDD -19% (SPY -47%), turnover 3.9x. Loses to 60/40 on Sharpe
  (0.83) - role is diversifier sleeve, not return engine.

Universe experiment (negative result, recorded in the roadmap):
- Merging the ETFs into an S&P 500 momentum ranking is a no-op: 0 of
  522 weeks put any ETF in the top-10 book. Defensive allocation must
  happen at the capital-split level, not inside the stock ranking.

Live default switched to the macro-defensive config:
- --universe sp500 (hardened fetcher: Wikipedia + retry + validation
  490-510 + committed src/data/sp500_snapshot.csv, self-healed by the
  workflow) and --target-vol 0.20, in both deploy and backtest.
- Backtested 2016-2026 @ 10bps: Sharpe 1.23, CAGR 23.7%, MaxDD -24.9%,
  turnover 8.8x; 2022 was -2% vs QQQ -33%. NASDAQ-100 aggressive config
  remains available via --universe nasdaq100 --target-vol 0.

Tests: tests/test_voltarget_synthetic.py (6 tests incl. bit-for-bit
identity and causality) + S&P 500 fetcher tests; all 8 suites pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
